subject.title: fix(cli): abort reaps autonomous executor process trees

question: Must explicit abort guarantee termination of autonomous executor descendants that create a separate POSIX session or process group, as described in the linked incident?
rationale: The patch safely kills the direct executor's group, but accepting process-group-only scope versus requiring stronger containment determines whether the reported credential-bearing survivor is actually fixed.

options.title: Require daemonized-child containment
options.body: Treat autonomous executor descendants as turn-owned even after they create a separate group, and require an appropriate containment design plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the supported guarantee
options.body: Accept process-group-only termination and narrow the documentation to state that separately daemonized descendants are unsupported and may survive.

recommendation.title: Require daemonized-child containment
recommendation.body: Treat autonomous executor descendants as turn-owned even after they create a separate group, and require an appropriate containment design plus live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing abort and intentional-background survival contracts originate in this person's merged history.
